Page.description: Root of a page document. Sets the theme and metadata. Children: SiteHeader, Main, SiteFooter in that order.

title.description: Document title for the browser tab and search results

Main.description: The page's main landmark. Put every section between the header and the footer inside it.

Stack.description: Vertical group of components with consistent spacing (e.g. the body of a lesson).

SiteHeader.description: Top navigation bar with the brand, up to six links and one call to action. Collapses to a menu on phones.

current.description: True for the language of this page

languages.description: Language switcher: one entry per language, in display order; the current one is marked

StatusBar.description: Thin strip of short facts above or below the header: an editorial ribbon or a status-page line (coloured dots by tone).

variant.description: ribbon = editorial small caps, status = monospace with status dots

Hero.description: First screen of a landing page. editorial = magazine cover with a photo; console = dark split with a log panel; adventure = playful with an illustration; cosmos, atlas and notebook = copy on the left and a live interactive package (or a drawing of orbits, a map graticule or an Ulam spiral) on the right.

note.description: Small note under the panel, e.g. 'Example drill replay'

prompt.description: Command shown at the bottom of the panel, without the $

values.description: Series drawn as the sparkline (e.g. minutes per module); omit for none

valuesLabel.description: What the sparkline shows, e.g. 'minutes per module'

panel.description: Log-style panel for the console variant

icon.description: Icon from the catalogue's icon set

label.description: Short label of the capability (2 to 4 words)

caption.description: One line shown under the orbit while this capability is highlighted

status.description: Roadmap status; shown as a Coming marker only in the actual landing mode

capabilities.description: Capability orbit for the product variant: cards on up to three orbits around the logo, one highlighted at a time

WorkflowShowcase.description: Tabs of realistic windows (a terminal, an agent session, a chat with tool calls, an API call, the studio) whose commands and answers are typed line by line, to show that the product can be run from agents and the command line as well as the UI. Each tab may carry a status badge; unbuilt interfaces must be labelled.

description.description: Text alternative of the whole animation for screen readers

LivingCourseStory.description: A looping three-beat animation: a source document changes, ulams finds every lesson and quiz question that cites it, and an approved proposal updates the lesson while learner progress is kept. Example values only.

intro.description: One or two sentences under the title

status.description: Roadmap label under the heading; omit when the feature exists

added.description: A new line typed after the edit

id.description: Anchor id for in-page links (letters, digits, dashes)

BuilderStory.description: A looping animation of the studio course builder: a document drops in, interview answers appear, an outline grows with a source chip per lesson, a lesson streams in with citations, a quiz question cites its source, a running cost ticks (example values) and Apply publishes the course.

intro.description: One or two sentences under the title

valueLine.description: One line of value copy under the animation

WhiteLabelStory.description: The white-label story of the product landing in four animated steps (an agent with the ulams CLI and a design tool's MCP reads a brand and applies its tokens, or builds a custom front on the headless API; get a themed site on its own subdomain, bring content and get one course per source, see per-course learner analytics), with a short numbered list under the stage. Every name, colour and bar in the stage is an example. Mark steps and sources that are not shipped with status 'coming'.

Each challenge may offer hints in tiers (nudge, then pointer, then near_solution), answer options that each explain why, and a worked solution that stays hidden until the learner has made an attempt.

options.description: Answer options; leave empty for an open task the learner marks as tried

quizHref.description: Where the quiz is: an in-page anchor on the quiz topic, or the topic link elsewhere

PendingUpdateNotice.description: Opt-in marker on a lesson whose source changed and whose update is under review ('The source of this lesson changed on {date}; an update is under review'). Shown only when the course turned it on. Filled by the app; authors do not place it.

id.description: Anchor id for in-page links (letters, digits, dashes)

CourseUpdates.description: Summary on the course page of what changed for a returning learner: lessons updated since they completed them, retired lessons, new lessons since they finished, and lessons whose update is under review. updated.description: Lessons updated since the learner completed them

retired.description: Lessons removed from the course that the learner had completed

extended.description: Lessons added after the learner finished the course
